lines.text: In this town, whatever number floats over your head
decides how strong your shadow twin will be.
The morning Leo turned eighteen, the whole sky went red,
and his counter glitched all the way to nine thousand nine hundred ninety nine!
And what stepped out of the portal wasn't a twin.
Wait, why did it come with a giant glowing snooze button?
he booped it right on the chest!
Always read the fine print before turning eighteen.
